title: Bridge Foundation Site, Concrete Mixers - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An elevated view of a major civil engineering project under construction, likely an overpass, highway interchange, or bridge abutment. Sturdy wooden formwork and scaffolding flank the deep trench, while several transit-mixer concrete trucks and a tall lattice boom crane stand on the muddy ground. A lone worker in a hard hat navigates the center of the muddy site, with flat farmland stretching toward the horizon.
